description: Composition by rule on music21: a seeded harmony planner (roman-numeral progressions with sevenths, applied dominants, the Neapolitan and the Italian, French and German sixths, five cadence types and pivot-chord modulation) voiced in SATB, a voice-leading checker (parallels, hidden fifths and octaves, crossing, overlap, spacing, ranges, unresolved leading tones and sevenths) and a figured-bass realizer. Chords sit on the roll's meter map, notes in 960 PPQ ticks. No model.
